# SD18 deterministic Human Sorcerer level 18 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Sorcerer
# level-1..level-17 spontaneous spell-burden baseline
# (tests/sd18_sorcerer_level17_widening.rs) to Sorcerer level 18 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat posture from
# the level-1..level-17 fixtures, and the same canonical bloodline and
# bloodline class-skill selections (Arcane, Knowledge [arcana]), adding only
# the level bump this cycle needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Sorcerer burden surface: no Arcane Bond
# execution, no bloodline arcana, no bloodline feat selection, no bloodline
# bonus spell selection, no spellbook, no which-spells-known selection, no
# spontaneous-casting execution, and no level-19+ progression. The PF1 CRB
# Sorcerer class table's level-18 "Special" column is genuinely BLANK
# (verified independently against d20pfsrd, a raw un-summarized parse of
# d20pfsrd's own HTML table, and the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror,
# all identical) — UNLIKE level 17's "Bloodline spell" entry, so no new
# pillar record is grounded from it. A genuinely NEW 9th-level spell column
# opens at level 18 on both the spells-per-day and spells-known tables (this
# cycle's own multi-source investigation definitively resolved the
# previously-flagged "premature 9th-level spell column" concern as the
# CORRECT reading, not a tool artifact — see the level-18 widening's own
# code comments and the progress doc for the full resolution), so this
# fixture exercises the newly-widened base-spells-per-day (8 -> 9 elements)
# and spells-known (9 -> 10 elements) arrays.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-sorcerer-level18-sd18-widening
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:sorcerer:18
ability=strength:8
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:17
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:sorcerer_bloodline:bloodline:arcane
choice=choice:sorcerer_bloodline_class_skill:knowledge:arcana
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
